rationale.complete: Only the D3 starting set of a ten-direction programme has run.
rationale.faithfulness: Rooms robustly beat random partitions and the exposure slope beats the rotation null (C = 1), but both locked size thresholds were narrowly missed, field-dominance and weak-coupling predictions failed, and room fields are not separated from coupling.
rationale.usefulness: Room-vs-random entropy and within- vs cross-room co-fluctuation are diagnostics anyone can compute on their own logs, but the payoff over simply knowing that rooms and instructions shape content is unclear.

one_line: Rooms are more like-minded than random groups but missed both locked sizes; order looks like room fields
